definition: A record of one change: the problem, the solution, the decisions that were settled, what is handed over and how a reader tells it was, and what was left out. Tickets are cut from it, and nothing else is cut.

A record of one whole task: when it is done, the thing it names can be done. It names its spec by identifier in its body, and says what to do, what counts as done, what was left behind, and what blocks it.
avoid: issue (issues live on a remote tracker, not in the repository)

definition: One task that can be done in a single sitting: when it is done, the thing it names can be done. A task that only prepares for another is not whole, and a task holding two complete tasks is not one task.
One line inside a ticket's work. It has no acceptance criteria of its own, and a ticket made only of steps is not whole.
Whoever works one ticket: a person or an agent, never both. A ticket needing a person is its own ticket however small.
avoid: owner (the arranger is not always the owner)

definition: A ticket whose work a person does rather than an agent. Its result is the only trace the work leaves, so it is recorded with hand-back.

The act of a person finishing one of their tickets and returning it: the skill works out which ticket they mean, asks what it needs to know, writes the result, closes it, and names the next. A person runs it; an agent does not.
avoid: report (a report is not a return)
handoff (that moves context to another session, not work back to the tickets)

definition: What a finished ticket left behind, in one or two lines and in a form a later reader can point at. It is written when the ticket is finished, not when it is cut.
avoid: output (when it names something a reader cannot point at)

definition: How a reader tells a spec's delivery was handed over: one sentence naming what is handed over, then one to three lines naming how a reader tells it was. Judged at the finished thing, not at a step toward it.
avoid: acceptance criteria (that is a ticket's checklist)

definition: A relation between two tickets that carries order: one waits for the other to finish. Blocking is the only relation between tickets.
avoid: prerequisite (when the direction is not made explicit)
parent (a spec and a ticket have no parent relation)

definition: The tickets whose blockers are all done, and so can be started now.
avoid: next actions (when referring to a personal list)

definition: The record of a discussion: each round's questions, the recommended answer, what the person said, the decisions reached, and what was left open.
The structure of a discussion, recovered from each question's Parent line rather than drawn a second time.
The accountable party of a record: the person who advances it and decides whether it passes. It differs from the creator, who only wrote it down.
avoid: author (when the accountable party is meant)
arranger (who does the work, not who answers for it)

definition: Anything this project gives an agent to work with: a skill, an MCP server, an interface, or a command line. A tool the person names is used ahead of the agent's own preference.
The YAML header block of a record, carrying the structured fields while the body carries the prose.
avoid: header (when it means the body's heading)

definition: A field on a record naming the way it was put: what was corrected, and why. Not a rule.
